## Assessment directory

### Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 practice

[Open the Environmental Science Exam Center →](../exam-center/){.btn .btn-primary}

Choose from **160 original practice questions** based on the two course presentations. Select a chapter, Science/Issues/Solutions topics, and any session length up to the available pool. Turn visual questions on or off; the visual set includes figures, animated systems and interactive energy experiments.

Explanations, chapter study links and a review list for missed questions help you plan your next session. These are study questions, **not official exam questions or predictions of your grade**.

Assessment formats, grading rubrics and official coverage will follow the instructor's current guidance.
